title: Equipment Datasheet - HEXANE FEED PUMP (GA-1201A)
content:
EQUIPMENT DATASHEET: GA-1201A (HEXANE FEED PUMP).
Document No: TJC-LLD-DS-GA-1201A, Revision: Rev 3, Status: Issued for Operation.
Equipment Type: Centrifugal Pump (API 610 OH2).
Plant Unit: Linear Low Density Polyethylene (LLDPE) Unit, Area: 1200 – Feed Preparation & Purification.
Functional Location: TJC-LLD-1200-01, Criticality: High Critical.
Service: Hexane feed transfer to 1st Polymerization Reactor DC-4501.
MECHANICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
Pump Type: Horizontal, End Suction, Single Stage; Model: 3x2x10 CDX-M; Rated Flow: 45 m³/h; Rated Head: 120 m; NPSH Required: 3.5 m; Differential Pressure: 8.6 bar; Pumping Temperature: 40 °C; Specific Gravity: 0.66; Fluid: n-Hexane; Viscosity: 0.31 cP; Casing Material: ASTM A351 CF8M (SS316); Impeller Material: ASTM A351 CF8M (SS316); Shaft Material: AISI 4140; Mechanical Seal: John Crane T2100, Single; Seal Flush Plan: API Plan 11 + Plan 62 Quench; Bearing Type – DE: 7310 BECBM; Bearing Type – NDE: 6310 C3; Lubrication: Oil Bath, ISO VG 68; Coupling: Flexible Spacer, Rexnord
MOTOR & ELECTRICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
Driver Type: Electric Motor, TEFC; Output Power: 30 kW; Poles: 2 Pole; Speed: 2970 rpm; Voltage: 380 V; Phase / Frequency: 3 Ph / 50 Hz; Rated Current: 56 A; Insulation Class: F (Temp Rise B); Enclosure: TEFC IP55; Frame: IEC 200L; Weight: 295 kg; Area Classification: Zone 2, IIA T3; Ex Protection: Ex nA IIC T3 Gc
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-1201, Interlock: SEQ-1201.

title: Interlock Logic & Cause Effect Matrix - GA-1201A (SEQ-1201)
content:
INTERLOCK LOGIC & CAUSE EFFECT MATRIX: SEQ-1201 (Hexane Feed Pump (GA-1201A/B) Shutdown Logic).
Document No: TJC-LLD-IL-GA-1201A, Revision: Rev 3, SIL Level: SIL 1.
Equipment: GA-1201A, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-1200-01.
CAUSE & EFFECT MATRIX (TRIPS):
- T1: Suction Pressure LOW-LOW (PSLL-1201 < 0.5 barg, 2oo3) -> Actions: Trip Motor (EFF-1), Close Discharge XV-1201 (EFF-2), Open Min-Flow FV-1201 (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-4), Start Standby Pump GA-1201B (EFF-5)
- T2: Discharge Flow LOW-LOW (min flow) (FSLL-1201 < 9 m³/h for 30s, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip Motor (EFF-1), Close Discharge XV-1201 (EFF-2), Open Min-Flow FV-1201 (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-4), Start Standby Pump GA-1201B (EFF-5)
- T3: Bearing Vibration HIGH-HIGH (VSHH-1201 > 7.1 mm/s RMS, 1oo2) -> Actions: Trip Motor (EFF-1), Close Discharge XV-1201 (EFF-2), Open Min-Flow FV-1201 (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-4), Start Standby Pump GA-1201B (EFF-5)
- T4: Bearing Temperature HIGH-HIGH (TSHH-1201 > 95 °C, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip Motor (EFF-1), Close Discharge XV-1201 (EFF-2), Open Min-Flow FV-1201 (EFF-3)
- T5: Motor Overload / Electrical Fault (MPR-1201 MPR relay pickup, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip Motor (EFF-1), Close Discharge XV-1201 (EFF-2), Open Min-Flow FV-1201 (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-4), Start Standby Pump GA-1201B (EFF-5)
- T6: Local/DCS Emergency Stop (HS-1201 Manual, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip Motor (EFF-1), Close Discharge XV-1201 (EFF-2), Open Min-Flow FV-1201 (EFF-3)
START PERMISSIVES (AND-gate conditions to start pump):
- P1: Suction valve OPEN (ZSO-1201, Gate Logic: AND)
- P2: Seal flush established (dP > 1.5 bar) (PDI-1201, Gate Logic: AND)
- P3: Min-flow valve OPEN (ZSO-1202, Gate Logic: AND)
- P4: No active trip / reset done (DCS reset, Gate Logic: AND)
- —: ALL permissives TRUE → START GA-1201A ENABLED (—, Gate Logic: AND)
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-1201, Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-GA-1201A.

title: One Point Lesson - Mechanical Seal Flush (API Plan 11) Verification (OPL-GA-1201A-01)
content:
ONE POINT LESSON (OPL): OPL-GA-1201A-01 - Mechanical Seal Flush (API Plan 11) Verification.

Equipment: GA-1201A, Discipline: Mechanical, Area: 1200 – HEXANE FEED SYSTEM.

References: Interlock: SEQ-1201 (SIL 1), P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-1201.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
Mechanical seal flush (api plan 11) verification for GA-1201A (HEXANE FEED PUMP) in the HEXANE FEED SYSTEM

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS:
- Precaution 1: Apply LOTO (Lock-Out Tag-Out) and prove zero energy before starting work.
- Precaution 2: Isolate, depressurise, drain and purge the equipment; obtain a valid work permit.
- Precaution 3: Wear the correct PPE: coverall, safety shoes, gloves, goggles and hearing protection.

- Precaution 5: Use certified lifting gear and correct manual-handling technique for heavy parts.

- Tool 2: LOTO padlocks and permit
- Tool 3: Laser/dial alignment kit (as applicable)
- Tool 4: Feeler gauges, dial indicator, seal/bearing pullers
- Tool 5: Correct spare parts and gaskets per the BOM
- Tool 6: Lifting gear and slings (certified)

STEP-BY-STEP PROCEDURE:
- Step 1 – Action: Line up discharge flush to seal chamber and open flush isolation
- Step 1 – Check: Isolation & LOTO verified
- Step 2 – Action: Check PDI-1201 reads 1.5–2.5 bar dP across the flush orifice RO-1201
- Step 2 – Check: Parts match BOM / spec
- Step 3 – Action: Verify no visible leak or drip at the gland / seal drain
- Step 3 – Check: Torque / clearance to spec
- Step 4 – Action: If dP low, isolate and inspect orifice RO-1201 for plugging by polymer/dirt
- Step 4 – Check: No leak / smooth operation
- Step 5 – Action: Confirm quench (Plan 62) N2/steam is lined up to the outboard side
- Step 5 – Check: Record in equipment history

COMMON PROBLEMS & TROUBLESHOOTING:
- Symptom: Hexane leak observed at GA-1201A seal gland during operation | Cause: API Plan 11 flush orifice RO-1201 partially plugged causing seal face overheating | Action: Replaced mechanical seal cartridge, cleaned flush orifice
- Symptom: GA-1201A tripped on VSHH-1201 high vibration 7.4 mm/s | Cause: Angular misalignment 0.12 mm/100mm after foundation settlement | Action: Laser re-aligned pump/motor, re-shimmed motor feet
- Symptom: Bearing DE noisy with rising temperature TI-1201 trend | Cause: Outer race spalling on DE bearing due to prolonged misalignment | Action: Renewed DE bearing 7310 BECBM, flushed housing, refilled ISO VG 68

KEY LEARNING POINTS:
- Point 1: Confirm seal flush dP > 1.5 bar before start. Low flush = seal face overheating and hexane leak to atmosphere.
- Point 2: Respect the interlock SEQ-1201: PSLL-1201 trips at < 0.5 barg – never defeat it without a permit.
- Point 3: Always cross-check the Datasheet limits and P&ID TJC-LLD-PID-1201 before working on GA-1201A.
- Point 4: Record the work in the equipment history so the Knowledge Hub stays the single source of truth.

title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - GA-1201A
content:
PIPING & INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM (P&ID) REGISTER: GA-1201A (HEXANE FEED PUMP).
Document No: TJC-LLD-PID-1201, Title: Hexane Feed System – GA-1201A.
